q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of making an LPG cylinder?
title: LPG cylinder carbon footprint per cylinder
short: Multiply the steel per cylinder (two halves, foot ring and valve guard) by the steel supplier's figure, then add deep drawing, welding, heat treatment, testing and painting energy. Divide by cylinders passed.

ul: Hot rolled steel sheet by weight.
Hydro testing, shot blasting and painting.

p: Report per cylinder by capacity. This is the cylinder's manufacture; the gas burned is a separate figure.

example.title: Worked example: LPG cylinder unit per cylinder (one month)
lines: Plant total: 66,250 / 50,000 = 1.325 kg CO2 per cylinder
Add steel and valve for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
